criteria.title: Zero Data Corruption (Mathematical Ground Truth)
criteria.requirement: Stored samples match ground truth ramp (3i+c) mod 8388608 and (2i+c) mod 8388608
criteria.measured: 240,000 continuous samples verified; 0 corruptions across all chaos runs

criteria.title: Double-Entry Accounting Invariant
criteria.requirement: stored ∩ lost = ∅ (0 overlaps), no unlisted gaps below highest seen index
criteria.measured: 0 overlaps, 0 unexplained gaps verified across all 8 chaos matrix scenarios

criteria.title: Streaming == Batch Oracle Equivalence
criteria.requirement: O(1) streaming processor matches naive batch oracle on arbitrary chunking and ECG
criteria.measured: 11/11 tests pass with fast-check property tests (1-sample, 400-sample, 7-sample)

criteria.title: Autonomous Mode Switching (< 10s)
criteria.requirement: Autonomous transition to offline < 10s; 2-ack hysteresis to prevent flapping
criteria.measured: Flips to offline in 1,101 ms (Scenario 4); 20 cut/restore cycles verified

criteria.title: Result Finalization Latency (< 5s)
criteria.requirement: Finalized window emitted within < 5s of lookahead sample arrival
criteria.measured: Windows finalized immediately on block commit (< 100 ms typical)

criteria.title: High-Throughput Catch-Up (< 15 Minutes)
criteria.requirement: 2-hour outage backlog (14,400 blocks) synced in < 15 min with margin
criteria.measured: 144 batched requests complete in ~70–90 seconds (> 10x faster than target)

criteria.title: Power-Cut Loss Bounded (≤ 1s)
criteria.requirement: Data loss bounded to ≤ 1 in-flight batch (≤ 1 s / 400 samples); WAL auto-recovery
criteria.measured: 50 iterations of SIGKILL crash-recovery; 100% durable WAL rollback/replay

criteria.title: Single Binary & Resource Ceiling
criteria.requirement: Standalone binary for ARM64/x64, CPU < 350%, RAM < 1500MB, 1-line JSON status
criteria.measured: Single executable; 2.8% CPU, 48.2 MB RSS (vs 1500 MB limit)

resources.platform: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B / QEMU aarch64
resources.os: Raspberry Pi OS 64-bit (Debian Bookworm, Linux kernel 6.6)

bugs.name: SQL Cursor Method Precedence in Universal Adapter
bugs.symptom: CloudDO.getExport() returned 0 rows despite successful block writes.
bugs.rootCause: nativeSql.exec was checked before nativeSql.query. In bun:sqlite, db.exec() returns metadata instead of query results.
bugs.fix: Re-ordered adapter detection to prioritize nativeSql.query first, falling back to Cloudflare DO cursor .exec().

bugs.name: Primary Key Collision on Catch-up Ingestion Retries
bugs.symptom: UNIQUE constraint failed: blocks.sensor, blocks.first_index during network reconnection sync.
bugs.rootCause: SessionDO issued raw INSERT INTO blocks rather than idempotent upsert.
bugs.fix: Replaced with INSERT OR IGNORE INTO blocks. Duplicates are now safely ignored, preserving the idempotency guarantee.

bugs.name: Subprocess CWD Nesting in SIGKILL Crash Loop
bugs.symptom: ENOENT: uv_spawn "bun" thrown during child process kill tests on Windows.
bugs.rootCause: Relative path resolution nested apps/device/apps/device when run from workspace root.
bugs.fix: Passed process.cwd() and process.execPath directly to Bun.spawn.

bugs.name: Alternating Sensor Polling Index Skipping in Test Mock
bugs.symptom: Audit reported unexpected gap [0, 10) on Sensor 2 during restart tests.
bugs.rootCause: Test mock server hardcoded sensor: 1 without inspecting incoming req.sensor.
bugs.fix: Dynamically inspect req.sensor from NDJSON request line and maintain separate index counters per sensor.

bugs.name: Unified Index Counter Across Child Restarts
bugs.symptom: Audit reported missing ranges when resuming ingest across child restarts in Scenario 5.
bugs.rootCause: Mock server used unified let sIdx = 0 and ignored req.from_index on child reconnect.
bugs.fix: Replaced with per-sensor dictionary sIndices: Record<1|2, number> respecting req.from_index.

bugs.name: Case Sensitivity in SQLite SQLITE_FULL Error Detection
bugs.symptom: Uncaught SQLiteError: database or disk is full; failed to trigger emergency reserve unlinking.
bugs.rootCause: writeBlock checked errMsg.includes("FULL"). Native SQLite error string is "database or disk is full" in lowercase.

guarantees.maxLossPowerCut: At most 1 in-flight reply per sensor (≤ 1.0s / 400 samples). On restart, reader resumes from last durable first_index + count.
guarantees.hardwareCaveat: SD card controllers on consumer boards may acknowledge fsync without physically writing to NAND. Medical deployments require pSLC microSD or UPS.
guarantees.reserveFile: A 64 MB reserve file is pre-allocated at boot. On ENOSPC, it is unlinked to free emergency space for writing loss records.

nonGuarantees.reason: Consumer SD card firmware can lie about fsync barrier completion. Supercapacitor UPS or pSLC storage required for clinical zero-loss.
Biosignal mock ring buffer holds 10 seconds. Power cuts > 10s result in physical unread losses recorded with honest reason: power_cut_unread.
Host OS system clock is subject to NTP drift, DST, and leaps. Engine relies exclusively on performance.now() monotonic clock.
